data.summary: The Google reviews appear largely authentic, with detailed, emotional stories from customers rescued from other builders. The perfect 5.0 rating with no critical reviews in the sample is a minor red flag, but the content suggests a contractor who excels at communication and problem-solving, earning strong loyalty. The lack of ratings on other platforms limits a full cross-platform analysis.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews praise the same two owners (Kim and Brandon) with similar phrasing
Lack of any critical reviews in the sample

positive_evidence: Reviews mention owners being available for questions years after installation
Owner rectified imperfections during build without customer noticing

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (e.g., plaster replacement, half-built pool rescue)
Emotional authenticity in stories of being scammed by previous builders
Mention of specific crew interactions and follow-up support
data.discrepancy_explanation: Insufficient data for comparison. Google shows a perfect 5.0, but Yelp and BBB lack ratings. No contradictory ratings found.

reviews.text:
Choosing Blue Diamonds Pool was one of the best decisions we made. From the initial consultation to the final walkthrough, Kim and Brandon were transparent, organized, and professional. They explained each step clearly, kept us informed, and followed through on every commitment. The quality of their work truly shows—our pool looks amazing and functions perfectly. It’s rare to find a contractor you can genuinely trust, and Blue Diamonds Pool exceeded our expectations in every way.
Thanks Kim and Brandon !!!
reviews.author: Kenny Le

reviews.text: You will not find a better pool building company than Blue Diamond pools. Brandon and Kim have exceeded all of my expectations. I appreciated the up front information and the fact there was never any hidden expenses or "I forgot to mention" fees. I knew exactly what my total cost was going to be up front. Each crew was respectful to our home/property and worked efficiently. Kim's attention to detail and communication is top notch. Even after the pool was complete, they took time out of their busy schedule to make sure I understood the science behind all the chemicals to keep my pool looking beautiful and the basics to keep my pump running flawlessly for years. I love our new pool it is exactly what I wanted. I could not have asked for a better experience.
reviews.author: Lynnley Burks

reviews.text: We picked Blue Diamond Pools for our project and could no be happier with the outcome! Brandon and Kim are very attentive and communicate exceptionally well. Even better than that, our pool turned out exactly how we wanted it. They found small imperfections (things that I didn't even notice) through the build and immediately rectified it. They were in our corner and wanted us to have an awesome product when everything was done. If you pick them, you will be happy with your pool!
reviews.author: Eric Neff

reviews.text:
It’s nearly impossible to find a trustworthy pool builder around here—and we definitely learned that the hard way. Our first pool company ghosted us. The second company built half a pool and then vanished with our money. They scammed us (and many others) out of over $25,000. What we were left with was a swampy, half-built pool wasteland that sat untouched for almost 3 years.

Enter Blue Diamond Pools, and everything changed.

We got quotes from multiple companies, some of which were DOUBLE what Blue Diamond quoted us. But not only were they more affordable—they were also the most professional, responsive, and reliable company we encountered out of the six we spoke with.

The difference between them and our past experience was night and day. What took Merlux months to (barely) do, Blue Diamond completed in just TWO WEEKS. The entire process was smooth, stress-free, and handled with clear, consistent communication. After everything we went through, working with them felt like a breath of fresh air.

The final result? Absolutely gorgeous. Better than anything I imagined when we first started this journey.

They were incredibly thorough and even made sure we knew how to care for the pool before they finished. Even now, they’re just a phone call or text away if I have any questions—and I do, often! 😅

After a nightmare experience, we finally have a backyard oasis, and peace of mind, thanks to Blue Diamond Pools. I cannot recommend them enough.

* ignore the overgrown garden, we haven't done much to it since the "wasteland phase". We'll get to it. 😉
* I included before pictures so you can see the incredible work that was done.
reviews.author: Sarah Fisher

reviews.text:
A Lifesaver in Pool Construction!

After a nightmare experience with a previous pool company that left us high and dry mid-construction, my husband and I were completely discouraged. Then Blue Diamond Pools came into our lives like a breath of fresh air! From our first interaction, their honesty, communication, engagement, and fairness were simply outstanding.

We had several frustrating hiccups from the previous builder, but Kim and Brandon at Blue Diamond handled everything calmly and methodically. They truly went above and beyond to make the rest of the pool building experience as smooth as possible. We couldn't recommend Blue Diamond Pools enough – we just wish we had gone with them from the very beginning! They are simply the best.
reviews.author: Ashley Brathwaite

reviews.text: When it comes to picking a pool builder Blue Diamond is the obvious choice.  We had a friend refer us to Brandon and Kim and after our first meeting with them we knew we wanted to have them build our pool.  The process from day one was a breeze. We didn't have one single problem  during the whole build. Brandon, Kim, and Morgan were always so quick to respond with any questions or concerns we might have had. They let us know when the decking was being poured so we could have our kids hands stamped in the concrete. It was taking too long to harden so we were only able to do their hands and not the date. We came back to the house two days later and saw that they had put the date under the hand prints for us. That was such a special thing that they didn't have to do but did it because they care and knew we wanted to have it there. We have been in our new home for 2 months now and are enjoying the long summer days we get to spend in the pool! Blue Diamond pools is a great company and I would recommend them to all my family and friends.
reviews.author: Scott Everitt

reviews.text: Brandon and Kim were amazing to work with. They made the process much less stressful and their team made my exact vision of my backyard oasis a reality and even improved it with some great suggestions. Their team was top notch and even though it's been two years since installation, we know that we can reach out to them for any questions.
reviews.author: Robin Moser

reviews.text: Kim and Brandon with Blue Diamond Pool are 1st class folks and can build you a 1st class quality pool! We would highly recommend them. Thanks Kim/Brandon!
reviews.author: Kris Roebuck

reviews.text: Blue Diamond recently replaced my plaster on my pool and I am extremely happy with the outcome and the Brandon and Kim are great to deal with.  They are always available for any questions and in my case additional tips on chemicals and equipment.  I highly recommend Blue Diamond Pools!!
reviews.author: Lonny Coffey

reviews.text: We are so glad we went with Blue Diamond for our pool build. Brandon and Kim were a dream to work with- always communicative, helpful, and involved. Brandon was at our house every time work was being done to ensure it was done well and to our liking. Whenever there were options on how to do something he would give us all the information (pros and cons) and support whatever decision we made. Kim kept us informed every step of the way and worked with us on figuring out what worked in our budget. The crews they used did great work and were always friendly. Our pool build was by far the easiest, most stress free project we’ve done and it turned out beautifully! Blue Diamond exceeded our expectations and we highly recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Courtney Gross

reviews.text: I absolutely love Blue Diamond Pools. Kim and Brandon are reliable, honest, and operate with integrity. They have always taken the time to answer any questions and instruct me how to operate my pool equipment... even coming over in freezing weather to patiently teach me how to winterize my pool. As a woman it can be difficult to find companies that I can truly trust. I am so grateful to have met such a great human beings with a great pool company.
reviews.author: Arine Derfler Ramon

reviews.text: My family and I chose blue diamond pools for our project and the entire process couldn’t have been any better.  Brandon and Kim were a pleasure to work with and the finished product is incredible. From design, construction, and follow up, there is no better pool builder than Blue Diamond Pools. They are honest, ethical, and overall just great people. Our family loves our Blue Diamond Pool and any chance I get, I will recommend Blue Diamond Pools.
reviews.author: Cody Durham

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Kim and Brandon at Blue Diamond Pools to build an in-ground swimming pool in our backyard.  I can confidently say that it was a truly exceptional experience from start to finish. From the initial consultation to the final touches, Kim, Brandon and team displayed unparalleled professionalism, expertise, and dedication, making them a stand-out pool contractor in the industry.

Outstanding Communication: Right from the beginning Kim and Brandon demonstrated excellent communication skills. They actively listened to our ideas and concerns, providing valuable insights and suggestions to turn our vision into a reality. Throughout the project, they kept us well-informed about the progress, and any changes or challenges that arose were promptly discussed and addressed.

Top-Notch Workmanship: The craftsmanship and attention to detail exhibited by Blue Diamond are truly commendable. The pool they constructed exceeded our expectations in every aspect. The materials used were of the highest quality, and their skilled team executed every stage of the construction with precision and care.

Impeccable Customer Service: Throughout the process, we felt like a valued client. Kim and Brandon were always approachable, friendly, and eager to address any questions or concerns we had. They went above and beyond to ensure that we were satisfied at every step.

In conclusion, I cannot praise Kim, Brandon and Blue Diamond Pools enough for their exceptional service and professionalism. Our new pool is a testament to their expertise and dedication. If you are looking for a reliable, skilled, and customer-focused pool contractor, I wholeheartedly recommend Blue Diamond Pools.    Without hesitation we give them a well-deserved five-star rating!

Marty & Julie
Kennedale, TX
reviews.author: Martin Buckley

reviews.text:
After much research, and interviewing numerous pool builders, it was without any doubt who was going to build our pool.  Brandon and Kim form Blue Diamond were not only very personable and down to earth, but they were extremely straight forward, no pressure, and came in well below the cost of every other builder we spoke with.

Communication was never an issue, we were always apprised of where we were and what was next.  Even with an incredibly rainy spring and early summer, they were able to get the job done with little delay as possible.

We absolutely LOVE the end result.  The pool came out absolutely perfect - even better than we ever imagined.  We were able to get more decking, upgraded equipment, and additional features that the other builders either didn't  offer, or if they did, were extremely expensive.

Thank you Blue Diamond Pools, for making our new homes backyard, our personal oasis!

If you are looking to build a pool, refinish, upgrade, anything...  do yourself a favor and give Kim and Brandon a call - you won't be disappointed!
reviews.author: Tom Sadin

reviews.text:
Had my pool built by Blue Diamond Pools by Brandon, and Kim. Me and my wife couldn’t be happier, the pool came out perfect, fair pricing, and great communication. Just remember… things don’t happen over night, and be patient. It took with rain delays almost 4 months. But is 100% worth it for an honest company and honest man. Brandon, and his company will make it correctly and done right. I wouldn’t choose anyone else.

Thanks again Brandon!
~Tim
reviews.author: Tim DFW

reviews.text: Brandon, Kim and Morgan were so great to work with. I cannot speak highly enough about our experience with Blue Diamond Pools. We have a smaller backyard, and they worked with us to design something that fit our yard and budget. We ended up with an amazing pool with a spa and Baja shelf. It was our first time doing this type of major project, and they walked us through everything and have continued to be a resource when we have questions. Their knowledge of design, materials, systems, etc was above and beyond.
reviews.author: Jennifer Wilson

reviews.text: My husband and I recently moved to the Midlothian area.  We are first time pool owners and to say we were intimidated to care for a pool is an understatement.   We called on the staff of Blue Diamond Pools and  Brandon and Kim were gracious enough to come to our residence to give my husband a period of instruction on the operation and general maintenance of the pool.  Brandon walked my husband through taking apart and cleaning the filters and back washing the system, maintaining the proper chemicals, how and when to shock the pool (and trust me it was completely necessary) and just the normal operation of a pool.  Blue Diamond Pools are friendly, professional and very knowledgeable.  Being the system was and older model was not a problem for Brandon.  He navigated through the system which made me feel comfortable using it.  We definitely will continue using Blue Diamond Pools for all our pool needs.
reviews.author: Louise Odom

reviews.text:
Blue diamond pools took care of our resurfacing needs. First time pool owner and was unsure who to go to. Was also skeptical about using home advisor but after getting a call Brandon at Blue diamond pools and how prompt they reached out an sent in a quote. We had our pool resurfaced in a weeks time. Professional and well done job for great price. Strongly recommend these guys if your  in search for any remodel jobs in DFW area.
Thanks again Brandon and crew.
reviews.author: Luis Marquez
